name: Argentina
summary: Southern Cone South American nation extending from subtropical Chaco savannas to Patagonian ice fields. Exploits massive Vaca Muerta shale gas while expanding Patagonian wind farms and Puna plateau solar installations.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 2.32x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); generally favorable maritime dispersion across Pampas plains.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; historic multi-year La Nina drought severely impacted 2022-2023 crop yields.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across Argentine meteorological stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.5% share of global fossil emissions; natural gas provides dominant domestic energy share.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Below world average per capita emissions; high natural gas share lowers carbon intensity vs coal.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Gran Chaco native hardwood forests covering ~285,000 km²; agricultural frontier clearing monitored.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Hydropower (21.4%), high-capacity Patagonian onshore wind (9.8%), and Andean solar PV (3.4%).

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 17 people/km²; highly urbanized with 92.4% in metropolitan agglomerations.
